protocol.policy_changes: NONE. Existing source-only original Go DK10/DK9 native and original Ygg R14/R13 local-cell decisions; independent C30 conventional temporal, R13 source-frozen no-learning, seeded random. No new navigation heuristic, externally supplied route, map, source seed as model input, unselected feedback or hidden answers. Original public C29 used for exactly matched FIT ONLY, never for live decisions.
protocol.model_and_control_exposures: All trainable roles start with the exact same 1664 real original selected public FIT events; frozen R13 receives original source checkpoint then chooses actual actions without local-cell updates; seeded random independently chooses actions; all seven roles receive equal 192 action budgets and original env.step each time; source could terminate.

diagnostics.real_public_key_held: image[3][6][0] == 5, before source action, no env.carrying
diagnostics.real_public_door_anywhere: any original 7x7 image pixel whose [0]==4, before source action
diagnostics.keyed_door_visible_anywhere: key_held AND door_anywhere before selected action
diagnostics.real_key_pickup_drop: changes in public key held bit before/after the selected original step, no read of private key state
diagnostics.after_key_pickup_duration: for each actual public key pickup, number of subsequent public before-action decision frames until actual public key loss or episode end; report number of pickups, losses within 1/5/10 actions and full retention span; right-censor episode-end spans
diagnostics.rotation_turns: For actual actions 0(left) and 1(right), count public direction before/after change matching original expected (before-1)%4 and (before+1)%4; also count any unexpected direction change for nonrotation.
diagnostics.visible_door_motion: For true same single original door visible both before/after, define pixel distance to front as |x-3|+|y-5|, closest door pixel; report change in this distance after each selected action, split keyed / not keyed and original action 0/1/2. No assertion of independent door identity or physical agent position.
diagnostics.front_door_toggle: Count exact selected action 5 when door is in front, with/without key; actual original public door state changed iff front original kind4 both before and after and state byte [2] changes.
diagnostics.context_conditional_actions: Distribution of action IDs 0..6 and per-condition support when carrying with visible door, carrying and no door, door ahead without key, key & door directly ahead, and no key / no door. This is descriptive selected public experience, not intervention.
diagnostics.no_public_change: exact SHA of original before public versus after public; does not imply no physical movement
diagnostics.real_goal_reward: original selected reward>0; only true upstream environment
diagnostics.source_resources: host CPU/wall/RSS not retail-PC energy; checkpoint and exact selected-source event hashes; two distinct complete independent OS process reproducibility

classification.priority: After original source/equal input/checkpoint and two-process integrity: if BOTH new native Go DK10 and Ygg R14 each make >=1 genuine original door public state change, BOTH_DOOR_EFFECT; else if either new native ever has key-held & front-door public observation, KEYED_FRONT_NO_BOTH_EFFECT; else NO_KEYED_FRONT. All statuses NO_SCIENCE.
classification.scope: Prospective diagnostic of frozen native source behavior; do not represent as a new learned navigation mechanism, independent statistical generalization, causal ablation, positive mission parser or superior to conventional. Stage follow-up can target identified retention vs orientation but requires separate prereg.
